purpose: A private weaving household that transitions the east-bank production waterfront into an inhabited residential quarter.
hero: west-facing high-ridge main hall seen through the courtyard gate

circulation.route: east water street -> 1.44 m gate -> stone court -> 1.012 m main-hall door
circulation.secondary_route: court -> 1.40 m north opening -> working weaving veranda
circulation.primary_arrival_exception: The 1.44 m gate is intentionally domestic rather than a public 2.40 m hall; it remains above the 1.20 m project circulation minimum and has visible depth and a real destination.

structure: continuous overlapped land support and street
thick split courtyard walls with two real openings
main hall with through door, two through windows, interior floor and furniture
solidified main-hall, gatehouse and veranda roofs
four veranda columns transferring load through four stone shoes
